reference: User-selected concept A; SHA-256 recorded as conceptSha256 in source.json.
body:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production sprite source for Roux's Adventure. Reference image is the USER APPROVED option A. Keep this EXACT character design: chocolate-brown small Pomeranian, short pointed ears, cream small diamond forehead blaze, cream muzzle and chest bib, cream paws, curled cream-tipped fluffy tail. Preserve A's friendly expression and compact puppy proportions. Translate faithfully to clean pixel art using flat brown and cream pixel clusters, dark brown outline, limited colors; no fine fur strands, anti-aliasing, texture, lighting effects or particles.
Output a clean production sheet on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background. No title, no text, no labels, no dividers, no borders, no floor, no shadows. Each character's silhouette is one connected shape; absolutely no stray pixels or separate accessories. All sprites fully contained within their cell with generous TRANSPARENT gutters, no overlap across neighboring cells, same pixel density and visual scale. Full-body quadruped sprites with slightly elevated/top-down camera as in Mystery Dungeon, not eye-level illustration.
Landscape 8-column by 5-row contact sheet, precisely FORTY sprites, regular equal-sized cells. Aim 2048x1280 with256x256 cells, characters about150x160px centered in cells with at least35px blank gutter. COLUMNS are the SAME in every row, in exact order: 1 FRONT facing viewer/south; 2 THREE-QUARTER FRONT facing screen-bottom-right/southeast; 3 RIGHT PROFILE facing screen-right/east; 4 THREE-QUARTER BACK facing upper-right/northeast with back of head visible; 5 BACK facing away/north, no eyes or muzzle visible; 6 THREE-QUARTER BACK facing upper-left/northwest; 7 LEFT PROFILE facing screen-left/west; 8 THREE-QUARTER FRONT facing bottom-left/southwest.
ROWS: row1 standing neutral rest with eyes open, feet planted; row2 walking stride A, left forepaw forward; row3 walking stride B, opposite forepaw forward; row4 short physical attack/bite pose, leaning forward with mouth open; row5 sleeping curled low to ground with closed eyes and muzzle resting near front paws. Same eight direction orientations in all rows. Do not use breathing row. Keep tail and body joined, preserve forehead and cream bib consistently. Species identity and body scale must not morph between poses. Arrange exact five rows and exact eight columns. No extra characters, no portraits.
portraits: Use case: identity-preserve. Make dedicated game dialogue portraits of the user-approved Roux option A (reference image). Preserve A's face exactly: small chocolate Pomeranian, pointed ears, chocolate cheek fur, narrow cream diamond blaze, dark round eyes, cream muzzle, small black nose and cream bib. Clean blocky pixel-art drawing with only 16 flat colors and hard dark brown outlines, no fur microtexture or smooth shading. Output one wide image of exactly THREE equally-sized square head-and-shoulders portraits in a single row on a genuinely transparent background, ample transparent space between heads. No title, text, frames, shadows or backdrop. Left NORMAL closed-mouth friendly smile. Middle HAPPY cheerful eyes and tiny pink tongue. Right SURPRISED round eyes and tiny open mouth. SAME face, same head scale and same centered framing across all three. Each face fills about85% of its square; both ears fully visible with a small top margin, cheeks equally distant from each side, head center on square centerline, eyes around mid-height, only upper chest bib visible at bottom. These are portraits designed from scratch, NOT body sprite crops. Low resolution appearance, intended for final40x40 game portraits. Keep A's charm and design, no accessories.
outputQualification: Generator output dimensions differ from requested dimensions. source.json records actual PNG dimensions and lossless strip rectangles. The exporter isolates silhouettes, reduces to the shared 16-color palette and native-size cells; generated pixels alone are not the production atlas.
